_meta.description: Style presets — editable config (PROMPT §2/§8). A preset is a named bundle of style options: one visual style for image prompts plus default voice settings for TTS. The options UI lists these; the user can override any value.
_meta.voice: voice/pace/tone are provider-agnostic starting values; real voice ids are validated by the selected TTS provider (M2).

presets.label: Clean minimal
presets.description: Minimal typographic visuals on plain backgrounds; clear, steady narration.
presets.visual_style: minimal typographic poster, flat plain background, generous whitespace, one accent color

presets.label: Photorealistic
presets.description: Photorealistic imagery with natural light; warm, conversational narration.
presets.visual_style: photorealistic photography, natural lighting, shallow depth of field, realistic textures

presets.description: Flat vector-style illustration with a consistent palette; upbeat narration.
presets.visual_style: flat vector illustration, consistent two-tone palette, simple geometric shapes, no outlines
